artifacts.summary: Five-phase plan closing both halves of the snapshot-artifact containment defect, with demonstrated-RED regression cases as the leading phase and a deploy/acceptance close.

memory_candidates.content: The ephemeral orchestrator runtime-file class has one definition point (scripts/lib/runtime-file-patterns.sh's five lockstep parallel arrays) but three coupled surfaces that must be reconciled in the SAME change: orchestrator-runtime-files.md's Consumer Repo Setup fenced block (byte-pinned by test-runtime-file-tracking.sh Case 3), the consumer repository's own specs/.gitignore managed block (regenerated by init-specs.sh; verify-deploy Gate 14's Check A fails otherwise), and index-entries.json's line_count for any edited markdown (check-extension-docs Rule R; deploy-headless.sh regenerates it, so the regenerated file must be staged). Adding a class member without all three is commit-blocking at deploy time, not merely untidy.
